Definition: Atsel, the name of an Israelite, and of a place in Palestine
BiblicalUsage: Azal = "proximity: he has reserved"; n pr loc; 1) a place near Jerusalem, site presently unknown; Azel = "reserved"; n pr m (CLBL); 2) a Benjamite descendant of Saul and Jonathan
